entry.name: rdiv
entry.description: Divides a number by the incoming value. Functions like the / object, but the inlets' functions are reversed.

arguments.name: divisor
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the divisor. If there is no argument, the divisor is set to 1 initially. A float argument causes the numbers to be divided as floats.
